5.Warping Prevention Tips

ABS is prone to warping when printing a large size and/or high infill density model. To avoid warping: 1) Not recommended to print too large size and/or high infill density model. 2) Use enclosure printers and ensure the build plate is properly glued before printing. 3) Set lower printing speed and higher heatbed temperature. For more details please refer to: Common print quality problems and solutions on WIKI.
6.Safety Tips

We recommend using an enclosed printer. At printing temperatures, this filament may release harmful gases, including styrene, which can cause dizziness or nausea. For extended operation, please wear a protective mask with a vapor filter (such as an activated carbon mask). If individuals with asthma or respiratory conditions, pregnant women, or children are present, please increase ventilation or pause printing with this material.

5.Nozzle Recommendation

Due to the addition of carbon fiber, PETG-CF requires a more wear-resistant hardened steel nozzle. While a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle can be used, a 0.6 mm hardened steel nozzle is recommended to further reduce the risk of clogging.
6.Z-Axis Strength
For stronger Z-axis adhesion, increase the infill density. Avoid using an open-frame printer and refrain from setting the cooling fan speed too high, as overcooling can weaken layer bonding.
